Reference: L. Monclús, H.P.H. Arp, K.J. Groh, A. Faltynkova, M.E. Løseth, J. Muncke, Z. Wang, R. Wolf, L. Zimmermann, and M. Wagner (2025). Mapping the chemical complexity of plastics, Nature, DOI:10.1038/s41586-025-09184-8.

references.Description: The PATENTSCOPE database from WIPO includes patent and chemical structure search (with a free account) that gives access to millions of patent documents. The World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO) is a specialized United Nations (UN) agency headquartered in Geneva (Switzerland). Our mission is to lead the development of a balanced and effective international Intellectual Property (IP) system that enables innovation and creativity for the benefit of all. We help governments, businesses and society realize the benefits of Intellectual Property and are notably a world reference source for IP information.
